description:
Creates a watchlist, or renames, archives or restores one.

Make one list per client or project, so each can be scanned and read on its own.
Creating a list costs nothing and scans nothing. Archiving hides a list and keeps
everything in it; restore brings it back. Add companies with
update_watchlist_companies.

Cost: free — call it as often as you need.

action.description: create needs name. update, archive and restore need watchlist.

description.description: Optional note on what the list is for, up to 500 characters.

name.description: Name of the list, up to 120 characters, unique on this account. For update, the new name.

watchlist.description: The list, by its id (wl_...) or its exact name.

name: manage_watchlist
title: Manage Watchlist
